name: What Is On The Walls Inside
source:
You explore your memories with Lou, a woman with a strong character but a soft heart. By doing this, you uncover how their relationship developed, finding more details on what happened.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=51388]Lemma Soft[/url]]
translation:
你与性格坚强却内心柔软的女性卢一起探索记忆。通过这一过程，你会发现两人关系如何发展，并揭开更多曾经发生的事情。

[来源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=51388]Lemma Soft[/url]]
